mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 60-day window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly employment surge exceeding 132,000 persons in PAYEMS triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting heightened labor market confidence and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during PAYEMS crossings above 132,000, or no correlation with the employment surge in the labor market expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signal market stability, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as uncertainty diminishes.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during concurrent GDPC1 and INDPRO increases, or no correlation between proxy movements and returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle, sustained federal funds rates below 2% lower discount rates, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS < 2% periods, or no correlation between FEDFUNDS levels and returns in the easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly demand surge exceeding 13,353 billion chained 2017 dollars in GDPC1 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days, signaling robust economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during GDPC1 crossings above 13,353, or no correlation with the demand surge in the expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) and concurrent demand growth (GDPC1) create synergistic market optimism, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and GDPC1 rise in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during concurrent PAYEMS and GDPC1 increases, or no correlation between proxy movements and returns.

mechanism_narrative: An expansionary supply index (INDPRO) exceeding 94.1852 in the supply domain triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days, reflecting robust production capacity and market confidence.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 94.1852 in the supply domain
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during INDPRO crossings above 94.1852, or no correlation between supply growth and returns in the expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rates (UNRATE) lowers equity risk premiums, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market expectations for stability improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during UNRATE declines, or no correlation between UNRATE trends and returns in the tightening phase.
